headline: No protesters appear for Trump’s Mount Rushmore fireworks six years after clash resulted in arrests
summary: No protests occurred on July 3, 2026 near Mount Rushmore during President Trump's visit, unlike six years prior when protesters were arrested.

headline: ICE raids Gallatin County sites, with as many as 100 detained
summary: ICE conducted mass arrests in Gallatin County, Montana; over 100 people detained in a week. Residents express concern about ICE's lack of coordination with local law enforcement and safety issues during operations near schools and worksites.
